START HERE — the doorway comes first.
Pick a shop; the page opens behind it.
The shop name beside the wordmark reopens it.

STILL YOURS TO DECIDE

1. Geolocation — should the doorway ask permission and put the nearer shop first?

2. A filled cart when someone switches shops — drop it, or re-price it?

Both are on the Locations board. Neither is designed.
